answer: In PoA, each identity must escrow bonded collateral, so coordinated equivocation by k identities incurs aggregate penalties proportional to k² through pairwise culpability links. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the sybil swarm, while asymmetric depreciation reduces recoverable stake faster than honest stake. Thus identities labeled meadow, basalt, and umber cannot cheaply diversify one operator’s risk.
